title: Live trade is plan-only
summary: Live-trade steps stay a checklist. They are never auto-executed.
narrative:
Mentioning 实盘 / live trade routes to `qt.ai.pipeline.live_trade_plan_only`. The skill writes a checklist and forbids sending orders.

Even when session.agent_auto is true and every allow_* flag is true, live steps stay dry-run. There is no allow_live.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
plan = assistant.plan('准备实盘交易', response_style='raw')
print(plan['plan']['steps'][0]['skill_name'])
risk_notes: Never treat a live checklist as an order ticket.
